title: Usage-based public developer API (stripped)
idea: A public web service that takes a company's web domain and returns descriptive attributes about that company: employee count bands, funding stage, hints about the software it runs. Billing is pure usage-based: $0.02 per successful lookup, with a free tier of 500 calls per month. The only authentication method is a static API key; no delegated-authorization flow exists yet. The underlying records are partly scraped from the open web and partly licensed from third-party feeds, and the refresh interval is promised as weekly. The customers are sales-automation vendors that batch-enrich their own customers' contact databases in overnight jobs.
focus_notes: Abuse / key leakage and unbounded batch jobs
Versioning / breaking changes for CRM integrators
Unit economics when free tier + scrapers dominate cost
